stories.title: Experiment supports theoretical foundation for potentially more error-resistant quantum computing
stories.desc: One approach to making information storage in quantum computing less prone to errors is known as topological quantum computing. It relies on special quantum states that are expected to be more resistant to local disturbances.

stories.title: Mapping Kīlauea’s Magma Reservoirs
stories.desc: Researchers used a dense seismometer network to monitor a combination of natural and truck-generated seismic signals and identify two regions of subsurface magma storage.
